item.title: CVE-2026-16319 · 4.3 MEDIUM — IBM API Connect Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
item.description: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.13 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to delete API keys belonging to other users due to improper authorization checks.
